ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following graphs show the permeability of ions during an action potential in a ventricular contractile cardiac fiber. Based on the graph, what is the resting membrane potential of the muscle fibers closest to?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two side-by-side graphs in the figure. The y-axis of the left graph is membrane potential (mV), and the x-axis is time (sec), showing the action potential of ventricular contractile muscle fibers: at the start, the potential is near about -90 mV, then rapidly rises to about +20 mV, enters the plateau phase, and then repolarizes back to a negative value. The y-axis of the right graph is relative permeability, and the x-axis is time (sec), showing curves of the relative permeability of ions such as Na+, Ca2+, and K+ changing over time. Reasoning: What the question asks for is the resting membrane potential of ventricular contractile cardiac muscle fibers. The resting membrane potential should be read from the baseline before the rapid depolarization of the action potential begins in the membrane potential-time graph on the left. This baseline is closest to -90 mV, therefore the answer is -90 mV.

raw_record.question_text:
The following graphs show the permeability of ions during an action potential in a ventricular contractile cardiac fiber.
Based on the graph, what is the resting membrane potential of the muscle fibers closest to?

method.method_draft: First describe the figure as two graphs: a left membrane-potential-versus-time trace and a right relative-permeability-versus-time trace for ions. Use the text to identify that the requested quantity is the resting membrane potential of ventricular contractile cardiac muscle fibers. On the left graph, read the baseline membrane potential before the sharp depolarization at the start of the action potential. This baseline lies closest to -90 mV, so report -90 mV.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个并列曲线图。左图的纵轴是 membrane potential (mV)，横轴是 time (sec)，显示心室收缩肌纤维动作电位：起始时电位在约 -90 mV 附近，随后快速上升到约 +20 mV，进入平台期，之后复极回到负值。右图的纵轴是 relative permeability，横轴是 time (sec)，显示 Na+、Ca2+、K+ 等离子相对通透性随时间变化的曲线。推理：题目要求的是 ventricular contractile cardiac muscle fibers 的 resting membrane potential。静息膜电位应从左侧膜电位-时间图中动作电位快速去极化开始之前的基线读取。该基线最接近 -90 mV，因此答案是 -90 mV。
